title: Opus 5.5 built a cozy and addictive tycoon game for me - the speed of development and quality is amazing
author: eveningwithcats
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/95h9t83b58th1.png?width=2164&format=png&auto=webp&s=584df73390a783b3c718b9ccc0054a404c9e54eb

Opus 5.5 developed a cozy and additctive tycoon-like game for me in basically 3x 5 hours limit on a normal Pro plan.

The game is fun to play and works in the browser. 3D models, textures etc. were provided by Opus 5.5. I only created the character and the eagle model (can be seen in the beginning) using Meshy. 

  
Having been "developing" browser-based games for the past 18 months or so using mostly AI only, I must say that Opus 5.5 brings another level of quality and speed into this.

My workflow was very easy:

\- I had a full spec plan written for another tycoon game (server and AI tycoon) and built this game with Astra. I asked Astra to look at the current game state and update the old specs

\- I threw these markdown files at Opus 5.5 and asked to transform this idea, the game mechanics etc. into a new-themed game, based on the Roman Empire.

\- Opus came up with a plan and compared the old game ideas and mechanics to the new ideas that Opus had

\- I was asked to make some basic decisions and whe chatted a bit about some details

\- I asked Opus to implement the game, and in the last iteration, I added a Meshy-based 3D model for the character

\- When I tested the game on my smartphone, I noticed I could not play it. It was developed for desktop PC, so I asked Opus to add mobile controls and optimize it a bit - and after around 3 minutes all changes were implemented and it worked very well on my phone

  
During the whole process, Opus also playtested the game for me and found the most severe issues. In my prompts, I asked to get updated with screenshots of the game and playtest results, so I could check if Opus is going into the right direction. It did in 9/10 cases, and I only had to correct some logical errors.

At the end, Opus implemented the current state of the game in 3x 5 hours sessions, which is absolutely insane.

What drives me crazy is that Opus added its own "juice" to the game, making it even better. I had my own ideas, true, but Opus was very good in picking up my intent and then growing these ideas and adding own aspects to the game that match my thinking. 

  
In case you want to check out the game, it is hosted here: [https://empire-tycoon.com/](https://empire-tycoon.com/) 

It is free to play and doesn't have any ads. I would say the first phase of the game is fully implemented and I asked some friends to playtest it. It needs some more polishing, though.

I also aksed Opus to document everything it learned and write me a skill file I can use in the future for similar games.

Some disadvantages I have noticed:

\- The game will not load properly on very old devices, possible it requires a GPU card that is not too old. Some rendering will be done on GPUs

\- The game will lag on very old mobile computers

\- The mobile experience might not be perfect
